thread:
Anna: Quick check — tenant-bridge canary for customer Nimbus is planned for tomorrow 09:00 PT. Who's owning egress fallback + airgap certs? Need owners + preflight checklist by EOD.

Kai: I can own egress fallback. Can someone paste the firewall egress CIDR/IPs? Need them to validate NAT and ACLs.

Sanjay: NAT mapping doc is here: https://rwd.co/drive/nimbus-nat — main blockers: customer uses a corporate proxy, we need proxy allowlist + their CA bundle for image pulls.

Leah: For airgapped certs: Security needs the CSR by 12:00. @deploy-bot will kick image sync at 02:00 UTC per runbook.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: image sync scheduled for 02:00 UTC. I will post success/fail in this thread.

Mike: Customer readiness update: Nimbus confirmed maintenance window 08:00–11:00 PT. They also asked if we can do a dry-run at 07:30 (pre-canary).

Anna: We can shift start — propose canary at 09:30 if dry-run at 07:30 works. Kai — does 09:30 break anything on your side?

Kai: +1 for 09:30. I'll prepare fallback scripts and smoke tests. Pinging @Sanjay for proxy allowlist details.

Sanjay: Need proxy hostname + port from Mike. Also cert rotation needs CSR + SANs: nimbus.internal, nimbus-gateway.

Mike: Asking customer now for proxy details and private registry creds. Leah — do we have an RBAC service account ready for Nimbus?

Leah: Yup, created 'nimbus-deploy' SA with read on packages and write to canary namespace. Will post creds once Security gives thumbs-up.

Anna: Security sign-off required: @Leah can you confirm CSR format follows spec? @Security, can you quick-check and flag anything blocking?

Security: This is Security — CSR format looks fine. One note: include keyUsage digitalSignature,keyEncipherment and set validity to 90d. I'll leave a brief comment on the CSR PR.

Anna: Action items: Kai — egress scripts + smoke tests; Sanjay — proxy allowlist + CA bundle; Leah — creds + open CSR PR; Mike — confirm proxy + creds with customer; Security — finalize CSR review. I'll collate preflight and post in morning.

Kai: Adding smoke test snippets to thread:
```
1) curl -I https://nimbus.internal/health
2) grpcurl -insecure nimbus-gw:443 Service.Health
3) tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/runtime.log | grep READY
```

Sanjay: Also adding an emergency fallback: route 10.0.50.0/24 -> nat-bastion (pre-configured) in case customer egress blocks everything.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: image sync completed — 24 images pushed, 0 failures.

Mike: Customer responded: proxy = proxy.nimbus.corp:8080, CA thumbprint = X1Y2Z3... sharing now. They will also provide registry creds via secure share.

Anna: :thumbsup: Updating checklist. If no new blockers by EOD, I'll mark canary go for 09:30 PT tomorrow.

Leah: LGTM.

Kai: :thumbsup:.

Sanjay: ack.

Security: Will approve CSR PR in ~30m.

Mike: Confirmed with customer, they acknowledged dry-run at 07:30.
